record.original_question: For the focusing nonlinear Schrodinger equation on the half-line, i u_t = u_{xx} + 2 |u|^2 u for x >= 0 and t >= 0, with prescribed initial data u(x,0) = f(x) and oscillatory boundary forcing u(0,t) = e^{i w t}, can one compute the long-time asymptotic behavior of the solution u(x,t) for general real driving frequency w?

evidence.quote: A particular stand out open problem is to compute the long-time behavior of the solution u(x, t) of the focusing NLS equation, iut = uxx + 2|u|2 u, with u(x, 0) = f(x), x >= 0, given and u(0, t) = e^{iwt}, t >= 0 with w in R.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the focusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the half-line,
   i u_t(x,t) = u_{xx}(x,t) + 2 |u(x,t)|^2 u(x,t),   x ≥ 0, t ≥ 0,
with prescribed initial datum
   u(x,0) = f(x),   x ≥ 0,
(decaying sufficiently fast as x → ∞), and with the purely oscillatory Dirichlet boundary condition
   u(0,t) = e^{i ω t},   t ≥ 0,
where ω ∈ ℝ is a given real frequency.

Determine the long-time asymptotic behavior of u(x,t) as t → ∞ in the various sectors of the (x,t)-quarter-plane (e.g. along rays x/t = ξ held fixed), for arbitrary real ω. That is, give explicit leading-order asymptotic formulas for u(x,t) — including the structure of any emergent modulated elliptic/plane-wave regions, dispersive zones, soliton trains, and transition regions — that are valid for general ω ∈ ℝ.
artifact.category_tag: Long-time asymptotics for integrable PDEs (NLS on half-line)
artifact.status_search_result: Boutet de Monvel, Its, and Kotlyarov developed a Riemann–Hilbert/Deift–Zhou framework for the focusing NLS equation on the quarter plane with time-periodic Dirichlet data, and obtained long-time asymptotics in certain regimes (e.g., specific ranges of the frequency and decaying initial data). However, a complete description of the long-time behavior valid for arbitrary real ω, with all transition regions and the full structure of the modulated zones rigorously identified, does not appear to have been established; the problem is generally regarded as still open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: The focusing NLS equation on the quarter plane with time-periodic boundary condition: a Riemann–Hilbert approach
status_evidence.snippet: Initial data vanish at infinity while boundary data are time-periodic; introduces a Riemann–Hilbert problem as a preliminary step to obtain uniform long-time asymptotics.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist via Riemann–Hilbert methods for time-periodic boundary data.

status_evidence.title: Long-time asymptotics for the focusing NLS equation with time-periodic boundary condition on the half-line (preprint)
status_evidence.snippet: Long-time asymptotics for the focusing NLS with time-periodic boundary condition on the half-line by Boutet de Monvel, Its, Kotlyarov.
status_evidence.claim: Asymptotics established in special parameter regimes, not for arbitrary ω.
